title: MEGALOBOX 2: NOMAD
synopsis:
In the end, “Gearless” Joe was the one that reigned as the champion of Megalonia, a first ever megalobox tournament. Fans everywhere were mesmerized by the meteoric rise of Joe who sprung out from the deepest underground ring to the top in mere three months and without the use of gear. Seven years later, “Gearless” Joe was once again fighting in underground matches. Adorned with scars and once again donning his gear, but now known only as Nomad.

(Source: TMS Entertainment)

episodes.title: Los fantasmas tararean un réquiem
episodes.synopsis:
Years after his victory at Megalonia, Joe has become a completely different man, going from one underground ring to another, now fighting as the wandering boxer Nomad.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: La desesperación da coraje a los cobardes
episodes.synopsis:
Joe gets his motorcycle stolen by a boy named Mio and ends up at a settlement for immigrants where he runs into Chief again.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Si deseas la dañina pudrición de las raíces, no bloquees la boca del ánfora
episodes.synopsis:
Joe helps Chief get ready to fight in the upcoming tournament while dealing with his own demons.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Si la flor del alma florece, el amor no se perderá
episodes.synopsis:
Chief fights in the last match of the tournament. Will he be victorious?

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: La tierra prometida respondió que el mesías no se quedará
episodes.synopsis:
Joe heads back home to face his past.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Aunque estés consciente de tu impotencia, Dios te ofrecerá su imagen para que la pises
episodes.synopsis:
Sachio ends up injuring a Megalo-boxer after they caused trouble at Bonjiri's shop. In retaliation, the Megalo-boxer comes back and trashes the place and steals the deed to the shop.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: El tonto que muestra su carta no es un payaso estúpido
episodes.synopsis:
Lieu finds out Joe is back in town and asks him to be his sparring partner. Mac Rosario had once lost everything, but made a miraculous comeback as the local hero.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Al principio del fin, la trayectoria del arcoíris dibuja un soportal
episodes.synopsis:
Mac and Liu face off in the ring finally. Maya goes to talk to Sakuma after she finds Mac acting strange.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Una sola mano no basta para vivir, pero aun así la forma de vivir prevalece
episodes.synopsis:
Joe continues to try to rebuild Gym Nowhere and Yukiko has some questions for Sakuma about BES.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Las derrotas pasadas son acompañadas por señales de buena suerte
episodes.synopsis:
The executives don't like Yukiko's decision to possibly end the company's partnership with ROSCO. Meanwhile, Joe and Sachio settle things once and for all.

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Cuando te quitas la armadura que no te podías quitar, brotan las semillas de la miseria y de la dicha
episodes.synopsis:

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: Aunque las ovaciones se callen, la voz de los mudos no desaparecerá
episodes.synopsis:

(Source: Funimation)

episodes.title: El con alas lleva al sin alas, y el sin alas bendice al con alas
episodes.synopsis:
Joe and Mac head into the ring to have their legendary match.

(Source: Funimation)
